title: Benchmarking Autonomous Driving Planners Across Leaderboards: A Unified CARLA-Based Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2509.22754v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Autonomous driving remains a highly active research domain that seeks to enable vehicles to perceive dynamic environments, predict the future trajectories of traffic agents such as vehicles, pedestrians, and cyclists and plan safe and efficient future motions. To advance the field, several competitive platforms and benchmarks have been established to provide standardized datasets and evaluation protocols. Each offers a unique dataset and challenging planning problems spanning a wide range of driving scenarios and conditions. In this study, we present a comparative case study of representative motion planning methods drawn from major benchmark ecosystems, including CARLA, nuPlan, and the Waymo Open Dataset. To ensure a fair and unified evaluation, we adopt CARLA Leaderboard v2.1 as our common evaluation platform and evaluate eight representative methods: TF++, InterFuser, TCP, PDM-Lite, MTR+MPC, CaRL, PlanT 2.0, Diffusion planne

translated_title: 跨排行榜的自动驾驶规划器基准测试：基于CARLA的统一评估
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶仍然是一个高度活跃的研究领域，旨在使车辆能够感知动态环境，预测交通参与者（如车辆、行人和骑行者）的未来轨迹，并规划安全高效的未来运动。为了推动该领域的发展，已建立了多个竞争性平台和基准，以提供标准化的数据集和评估协议，每个平台都提供独特的数据集和具有挑战性的规划问题，涵盖广泛的驾驶场景和条件。在本研究中，我们对来自主要基准生态系统（包括CARLA、nuPlan和Waymo开放数据集）的代表性运动规划方法进行了比较案例研究。为了确保公平和统一的评估，我们采用CARLA Leaderboard v2.1作为共同的评估平台，并评估了八种代表性方法：TF++、InterFuser、TCP、PDM-Lite、MTR+MPC、CaRL、PlanT 2.0和Diffusion planner。
tldr: 本研究以CARLA Leaderboard v2.1作为统一评估平台，对来自CARLA、nuPlan和Waymo开放数据集等主要基准生态系统的八种代表性自动驾驶运动规划方法进行了公平的跨排行榜比较评估。
en_tdlr: This study conducts a unified and fair cross-leaderboard comparison of eight representative autonomous driving motion planners from major benchmark ecosystems (CARLA, nuPlan, and Waymo Open Dataset) using CARLA Leaderboard v2.1 as the common evaluation platform.
